summary: Join our Fish Farming Training Course to master aquaculture practices. Gain valuable knowledge and skills to succeed in the fish farming industry.
lede: Fish farming training covers the practical management of aquatic production, including water quality, feeding, and fish health. For farm managers, hatchery technicians, and other aquaculture professionals, it supports production across hatchery and farm operations with water-quality monitoring, feed conversion ratio calculations, recirculating system planning, and biosecurity protocols.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for professionals operating across the aquaculture value chain, from hands-on production to strategic investment.
modules: Water Quality Management and IoT Monitoring
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of agricultural operations, biological sciences, or farm management. No prior coding or advanced engineering experience is required. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet software (e.g., Microsoft Excel) is recommended for the financial and feed calculation exercises.
